title: Eric Liu
gallery_text: An experimental interface for identifying potential areas of gentrification through an analysis of Open Street Map Places and NYU Furman/ACS rent data.

answers.interest: I'm interested in this class because I'm hoping to explore how simulations can help us explore, understand, and model more complex systems/processes. Additionally, I'm hoping to learn more about creative and critical methods of data analysis/forecasting, as well as how best to represent data in the context of a greater narrative.
answers.suggestions: I'm particularly interested in examples like the City Sim and the design and management of a large system of rules and variables.
